'''Juntrack''' was the largest [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Inquiesse]] continent, on the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] of [[Draenell's Point]]. Juntrack was one of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] leading manufacturing centers,<ref name="GK" /> and was home to [[Draenell Industries]].<ref name="CTB">{{WEGCite|story=Changing the Balance|book=Star Wars Gamemaster Kit}}</ref> It was situated around [[Juntrack River]] valley, and was home to three million inhabitants.<ref name="GK" />
